name: Gahz'ridian
summary: In Tanaris, Marvon Rivetseeker searches for thirty ornaments left by its old trolls. He gives you a detector of his own making to help find them.

sections.title: Relics of the Hydra God
sections.body: Long ago, trolls lived in Tanaris and carved ornaments in the likeness of Gahz'rilla, the hydra they revered as a god. Marvon Rivetseeker named the element in the carvings Gahz'ridian, after the hydra. He has found a few ornaments and wants more to study.

sections.title: The Detector
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker gives you a detector he invented to make finding Gahz'ridian easier. Wear it, and the search begins. The ornaments may lie almost anywhere in Tanaris. They are thickest near Broken Pillar, the Eastmoon Ruins and the Southmoon Ruins.

faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker is a scientist in Tanaris who studies ornaments made by the old trolls and has a heart for treasure hunting.
Gahz'ridian is the name Marvon Rivetseeker gave the element carved into the trolls' ornaments of the hydra god.
Gahz'rilla is a hydra the old trolls revered as a god. They carved ornaments in its likeness.
Gahz'ridian ornaments may be found almost anywhere in Tanaris, but they are thickest near Broken Pillar, the Eastmoon Ruins and the Southmoon Ruins.

faq.q: How do you find the ornaments?
faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker invented a detector to help find the ornaments. Wear it to begin the search.
